name: Should I choose a walk-in shower or a curbed shower for my conversion?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a walk-in shower or a curbed shower for my conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between a walk-in (curbless) shower and a curbed shower depends on your preferences and needs. A walk-in, or curbless, shower offers seamless entry, enhancing accessibility and providing a sleek, modern aesthetic that makes the bathroom feel larger. However, it often requires more extensive sub-floor modifications for proper drainage. A curbed shower, with a raised threshold, is typically simpler to install and can be a more cost-effective option, offering effective water containment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walk-in (curbless) showers offer accessibility and modern aesthetics but require more floor work; curbed showers are simpler, cost-effective, and contain water well.
